name: 组长拆解流程
description: L2 组长层任务拆解，把大任务分解为多个可执行的子任务
author: Pipeline-Sys

nodes.name: 接收任务
nodes.expression: ({ task_id: inputs.task_id, title: inputs.title, lead_role: inputs.lead_role, started_at: new Date().toISOString() })

nodes.name: 准备拆分输入
nodes.description: 构建 AI 任务拆分的输入数据
nodes.expression: (() => { return JSON.stringify({ task_id: inputs.task_id, title: inputs.title, description: inputs.description, lead_role: inputs.lead_role, max_subtasks: inputs.max_subtasks, project_context: 'Footnote 游戏项目 - 叙事驱动2D系统策略冒险游戏' }); })()

nodes.name: AI 分析任务范围
nodes.description: 调用 cursor-agent 智能分析任务拆分

nodes.name: 降级分析
nodes.description: AI 分析失败时使用关键词匹配
nodes.expression: (() => { const desc = inputs.description.toLowerCase(); const modules = []; if (desc.includes('ui') || desc.includes('界面')) modules.push('ui'); if (desc.includes('系统') || desc.includes('功能')) modules.push('systems'); if (desc.includes('对白') || desc.includes('剧情')) modules.push('narrative'); if (desc.includes('测试')) modules.push('qa'); if (modules.length === 0) modules.push('general'); return { complexity: modules.length > 3 ? 'complex' : 'normal', estimated_hours: 4, modules: modules, subtasks: modules.map((m, i) => ({ id: 'SUB' + (i+1), title: inputs.title + ' - ' + m, description: '(由组长填写)', role: 'L3_engineer', priority: 'normal', estimated_hours: 2 })), dependencies: [], risks: ['使用降级分析，建议人工确认'], summary: '降级分析结果，建议人工复核' }; })()

nodes.name: 解析拆分结果
nodes.description: 解析 cursor-agent 返回的 JSON
nodes.expression: (() => { try { const result = JSON.parse(nodes.ai_analyze_scope.output.stdout); return { complexity: result.complexity || 'normal', estimated_hours: result.estimated_hours || 4, modules: result.modules || ['general'], subtasks: result.subtasks || [], dependencies: result.dependencies || [], risks: result.risks || [], summary: result.summary || '分析完成' }; } catch(e) { return { complexity: 'normal', estimated_hours: 4, modules: ['general'], subtasks: [], dependencies: [], risks: ['解析失败'], summary: '解析 AI 结果失败' }; } })()

nodes.name: 整合分析结果
nodes.description: 整合 AI 或 fallback 的分析结果
nodes.expression: (() => { const result = nodes.parse_decompose_result ? nodes.parse_decompose_result.output : (nodes.fallback_analyze ? nodes.fallback_analyze.output : {}); return { modules: result.modules || ['general'], subtasks: result.subtasks || [], estimated_subtasks: (result.subtasks || []).length || result.modules.length || 1, complexity: result.complexity || 'normal', estimated_hours: result.estimated_hours || 4, dependencies: result.dependencies || [], risks: result.risks || [], summary: result.summary || '' }; })()

nodes.name: 检查复杂度
nodes.description: 判断是否需要拆分为多个子任务

nodes.name: 生成子任务
nodes.description: 根据分析结果生成多个子任务 TaskPack
nodes.command: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const parentId = '${inputs.task_id}'; const title = '${inputs.title}'.replace(/'/g, ''); const modules = ${JSON.stringify(nodes.analyze_scope.output.modules || ['general'])}; const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').slice(0, 15); const subtasks = modules.map((mod, i) => { const taskId = parentId + '-SUB' + (i+1); const fileName = taskId + '_' + mod + '.md'; const relPath = 'design/ai-native/03_taskpacks/' + fileName; const content = ['---', 'task_id: ' + taskId, 'parent_task: ' + parentId, 'title: \"' + title + ' - ' + mod + '\"', 'module: ' + mod, 'task_type: code', 'complexity: normal', '---', '', '# TASK-PACK: ' + taskId, '', '## 模块: ' + mod, '', '## 1. Outcome', '(由组长填写具体交付物)', '', '## 2. Allowed Inputs', '- [`dir`] `./`', '', '## 3. Deliverables', '- (待定)', '', '## 4. Constraints', '- 不得修改冻结目录', '', '## 5. Acceptance Checklist', '- [ ] 交付物落盘', ''].join('\n'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(relPath), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(relPath, content); return { task_id: taskId, module: mod, path: relPath }; }); console.log(JSON.stringify({ parent_id: parentId, subtasks }));"

nodes.name: 生成单个 TaskPack
nodes.description: 任务简单，直接生成一个 TaskPack
nodes.command: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const taskId = '${inputs.task_id}'; const title = '${inputs.title}'.replace(/'/g, ''); const desc = '${inputs.description}'.replace(/'/g, ''); const fileName = taskId + '_task.md'; const relPath = 'design/ai-native/03_taskpacks/' + fileName; const content = ['---', 'task_id: ' + taskId, 'title: \"' + title + '\"', 'task_type: code', 'complexity: normal', '---', '', '# TASK-PACK: ' + taskId, '', '## 1. Outcome', desc, '', '## 2. Allowed Inputs', '- [`dir`] `./`', '', '## 3. Deliverables', '- (由执行者确定)', '', '## 4. Constraints', '- 不得修改冻结目录', '', '## 5. Acceptance Checklist', '- [ ] 交付物落盘', ''].join('\n'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(relPath), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(relPath, content); console.log(JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId, path: relPath, is_single: true }));"
